Solid oak blocks indicate usable storage; blue lines indicate glazing. Interior doors shown open.
Room dimensions are nominal planning zones including wall allowance, not measured net room areas.
Main stair opening 8 x 15 ft. 20 risers over 11 ft; 6.6 in nominal rise and 11 in tread.
